authorization: User explicitly authorized scoped implementation, execution and branch/PR publication; no merge or deployment.

gates.name: contract freeze
gates.rule: All six lanes may inspect first. Root releases production work only after state, tokens, cancellation order and host surface agree.
gates.evidence: CONTRACT.md and six root release messages

gates.name: compiler input
gates.rule: N2 builds actual N1 package through existing GoScript CLI. No synthetic AppIR or hidden JavaScript reducer.
gates.evidence: N1 app.go/view.go then captured actual CLI diagnostics and builds

gates.name: shared script
gates.rule: N1/N4/N5 agree the lifecycle-style source script, preserving physical click paths and tick-free swaps/probes.

gates.name: independent cross-review
gates.rule: Native review packets become ready only after author completion; author cannot review own packet.
gates.evidence: state.json events plus native/epoch-*.json and bundles

gates.name: full acceptance
gates.rule: Freeze integrated source and independent reviews before exact-source full inherited/new acceptance; any repair creates a new reviewed checkpoint.
gates.status: released: all 32 source and historical-custody packets closed, nested amendments independently accepted; exact-source full run remains pending

gates.name: publication
gates.rule: Feature/review branches and PR only. Main merge and production deployment excluded.

allocation_boundary: The native solver recommends assignments. Separate collaboration calls deliver actual worker tasks; native start records acknowledge those calls. The probe does not dispatch agents.
